dialogues.jp: 退屈だな。
dialogues.en: I'm bored.
dialogues.text: I'm bored.

dialogues.jp: いったい、俺は何を思ってここに来たんだ？
dialogues.en: What was I thinking, coming here?
dialogues.text: What was I thinking, coming here?

dialogues.jp:
何か素敵な出来事でもあるはずと、幻想を抱い
たのか？
dialogues.en: Was I expecting something wonderful to happen?
dialogues.text: Was I expecting something wonderful to happen?

dialogues.jp: 「ゲームじゃないっつーのに……ん？」
dialogues.en: "Like I'm a character in a game or something...... huh?"
dialogues.text: "Like I'm a character in a game or something...... huh?"

dialogues.jp:
廊下の先――階段のある曲がり角に、人影が見
えた気がする。
dialogues.en:
I thought I saw someone down the hallway, by the corner of
stairs.
dialogues.text:
I thought I saw someone down the hallway, by the corner of
stairs.

dialogues.jp:
一瞬だったからどんなやつかは分からないが、
間違いなく、誰かが階段を上っている。
dialogues.en:
It was quick, just for a second so I don't know who it was,
but someone's definitely climbing up the stairs.
dialogues.text:
It was quick, just for a second so I don't know who it was,
but someone's definitely climbing up the stairs.

dialogues.jp: 「……あやしい」
dialogues.en: "......It's suspicious."
dialogues.text: "......It's suspicious."

dialogues.jp: 日曜に学園をうろついているなど、怪しすぎる。
dialogues.en: Who would walk around inside the school on Sunday?
dialogues.text: Who would walk around inside the school on Sunday?

dialogues.jp: 俺以外のやつは。
dialogues.en: Except for me.
dialogues.text: Except for me.

dialogues.jp: 「正体を突き止めるか……」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to find out who it was......"
dialogues.text: "I'm going to find out who it was......"

dialogues.jp:
退屈な時間にふってわいた暇つぶしの材料に、
俺は後を追うことにする。
dialogues.en:
I found something to do, and I decided to follow that
person.
dialogues.text:
I found something to do, and I decided to follow that
person.

dialogues.jp: スッ――と気配を殺し、足早に廊下を進む。
dialogues.en: I quietly moved down the hallway.
dialogues.text: I quietly moved down the hallway.

dialogues.jp: 上のほうから、階段を上る音が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: I could hear someone climbing up the stairs.
dialogues.text: I could hear someone climbing up the stairs.

dialogues.jp:
俺は足音を忍ばせながら、階段を一段ずつ慎重
に上っていく。
dialogues.en: I took the steps up slowly but surely.
dialogues.text: I took the steps up slowly but surely.

dialogues.jp:
階段を上りきるごとに腰をかがめ、そっと顔だ
け出して上を窺いながら近づく。
dialogues.en:
Every time I reached the top of the stairs, I ducked and
looked around to make sure no one was watching.
dialogues.text:
Every time I reached the top of the stairs, I ducked and
looked around to make sure no one was watching.

dialogues.jp: はたから見たら、俺の方が怪しく見えるだろう。
dialogues.en: I might be the one who looked the most suspicious.
dialogues.text: I might be the one who looked the most suspicious.

dialogues.jp: 足音がはっきり聞こえるようになった……。
dialogues.en: I can clearly hear the footsteps now......
dialogues.text: I can clearly hear the footsteps now......

dialogues.jp: そろそろ追いついたか？
dialogues.en: Am I almost there?
dialogues.text: Am I almost there?

dialogues.jp: と、キイイっと重たい音が響いた。
dialogues.en: I ducked and slowly looked up toward the next set of stairs.
dialogues.text: I ducked and slowly looked up toward the next set of stairs.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Hey? Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Hey? Asakura?"

dialogues.jp:
上にいた怪しげな人物――眞子が俺の足音に気
づき、こちらを見下ろす。
dialogues.en:
The suspicious person, Mako, realized I was there and looked
down at me.
dialogues.text:
The suspicious person, Mako, realized I was there and looked
down at me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子の声に、隣にいた萌先輩も扉を振り返る。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai also turned back, as she stood next to Mako.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai also turned back, as she stood next to Mako.

dialogues.jp: 「よっ。何してんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey! What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "Hey! What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしたちは演奏の練習をしにきたんだけど」
dialogues.en: "We came here to practice our music."
dialogues.text: "We came here to practice our music."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん……音楽部の？」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... for the music club?"
dialogues.text: "Oh...... for the music club?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ。ふたりだけです」
dialogues.en: "No, it's only the two of us."
dialogues.text: "No, it's only the two of us."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「自主練か？」
dialogues.en: "A private lesson?"
dialogues.text: "A private lesson?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子の顔を見て、萌先輩の言葉を確認する。
dialogues.en: I looked at Mako's face as I listened to Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: I looked at Mako's face as I listened to Moe-sempai.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「日曜に、わざわざご苦労だな」
dialogues.en: "You guys are working hard on Sunday!"
dialogues.text: "You guys are working hard on Sunday!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それより、なんであんたがいるのよ。もしか
　して、呼び出し？」
dialogues.en: "Not really."
dialogues.text: "Not really."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「違うって」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, why are you here? Were you called here by the
teacher for doing something bad?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, why are you here? Were you called here by the
teacher for doing something bad?"

dialogues.jp: なんですぐ、そこに行き当たるのかコイツは。
dialogues.en: "No."
dialogues.text: "No."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの、では朝倉くんはどうしてここにいるん
　ですか？」
dialogues.en: Why does she always want to draw that conclusion?
dialogues.text: Why does she always want to draw that conclusion?

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「散歩です」
dialogues.en: "So why are you here, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "So why are you here, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「散歩……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "You're taking a walk......?"
dialogues.text: "You're taking a walk......?"

dialogues.jp:
全てを鵜呑みにする萌先輩も、不思議そうな顔
をする。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai asked with a surprised expression on her face.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai asked with a surprised expression on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「なんで学園なんか散歩してんのよ。公園に行
　けばいいじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"Why are you taking a walk inside the school? Why don't you
go to the park?"
dialogues.text:
"Why are you taking a walk inside the school? Why don't you
go to the park?"

dialogues.jp:
まったくだ。その点については、俺も激しく同
感だ。
dialogues.en: She's right. I feel the same way.
dialogues.text: She's right. I feel the same way.

dialogues.jp: （どうして俺は、ここに来てしまったのか？）
dialogues.en: (How did I end up here?)
dialogues.text: (How did I end up here?)

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、誰もいない学園を歩いてみたかったっ
　てことだろ」
dialogues.en:
"I just wanted to take a walk in the school when it was
empty."
dialogues.text:
"I just wanted to take a walk in the school when it was
empty."

dialogues.jp: 自分で言いながら、バカらしくなってくる。
dialogues.en:
I was starting to feel silly for saying that. Why am I doing
such a senseless thing?
dialogues.text:
I was starting to feel silly for saying that. Why am I doing
such a senseless thing?

dialogues.jp:
何で｛・・・・／この俺が｝、そんなかったるいことをしてる
んだ？
「やっぱ帰る」
dialogues.en: "I'm going home now."
dialogues.text: "I'm going home now."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんた何しに来たの？」
dialogues.en: "Why did you come here then?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you come here then?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……その答えを探しに来たのさ」
dialogues.en: "I came to find an answer......"
dialogues.text: "I came to find an answer......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「アディオス！」
dialogues.en: "Adios!"
dialogues.text: "Adios!"

dialogues.jp: かっこよく手を振ってふたりに背を向けた。
dialogues.en: I waved and turned my back to them.
dialogues.text: I waved and turned my back to them.

dialogues.jp:
｛さっそう／颯爽｝と、いなせに、屋上から逃げるように校内
に戻る。
dialogues.en: I ran back into the school from the rooftop.
dialogues.text: I ran back into the school from the rooftop.

dialogues.jp: ほんと、暇つぶしにしかならなかった……。
dialogues.en: That was really pointless......
dialogues.text: That was really pointless......

dialogues.en: "I'm bored...... I'm going home now."
dialogues.text: "I'm bored...... I'm going home now."

dialogues.jp: ◆屋上にて練習◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lesson on the rooftop◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lesson on the rooftop◆

dialogues.jp:
何となく学園にやって来た。と、怪しい人影を
発見。俺はそれを追跡した。
dialogues.en:
I came to the school to wander around. I found someone
suspicious. I decided to follow them.
dialogues.text:
I came to the school to wander around. I found someone
suspicious. I decided to follow them.

dialogues.jp:
着いた先は屋上。そこには萌先輩と眞子の二人
が居た。音楽部の自主練らしい。日曜なのに、
ご苦労な事だ。
dialogues.en:
I arrived at the rooftop. Mako and Moe-sempai were there.
They were practicing their music. They're working hard even
on Sunday.
dialogues.text:
I arrived at the rooftop. Mako and Moe-sempai were there.
They were practicing their music. They're working hard even
on Sunday.
